_comment: Copy of builder/proof-page/src/services.json (read 20 Nov 2026) without the contact email. Prices here are the ones published on each service page of giannis-builds.pages.dev. No ratings, no reviews.

person.name: Giannis Plevris
person.jobTitle: Cloudflare Workers and internal tools developer

services.name: Internal tools on Cloudflare Workers
services.description: One internal tool on the client's own Cloudflare account: a request form, a D1 database, alerts by email or Telegram and a dashboard, with Cloudflare Access roles, an audit log, CSV export, Playwright tests and a handover doc. Fixed price.

offers.name: Ops tool, Starter
offers.description: One workflow: form, D1 database, alerts by email or Telegram, dashboard; login and roles through Cloudflare Access; audit log and CSV export; Playwright tests; handover doc. Delivered in 7 days.

offers.name: Ops tool, Standard
offers.description: Starter, plus up to 3 screens and 1 integration (Google Sheets, Telegram or a webhook). Delivered in 10 days, paid in two milestones of 50 % each.

services.name: Klaviyo flows setup for Shopify: Core Five
services.description: Five Klaviyo flows for a Shopify store (welcome, abandoned checkout, browse abandonment, post-purchase, winback with a sunset rule) and fourteen emails, built in Draft in the store's own Klaviyo account, with a deliverability check, QA, a handover doc and a day-14 read-out. Fixed price.

offers.name: Core Five, founding price
offers.description: All five flows and fourteen emails in 7 days. Founding price for the first 2 Core Five brands, then USD 750.

offers.name: Checkout Recovery
offers.description: Abandoned checkout (3 emails) and browse abandonment (2 emails), one template, the deliverability check and QA, in 3 days.

services.name: App Store preview videos from your screen recordings
services.description: App Store preview videos cut from the app's own screen recordings at the sizes Apple accepts, each file measured against Apple's published specification, with a poster frame and a spec report; Google Play video, feature graphic and social cuts on the larger tiers. Fixed price.

offers.name: Starter
offers.description: One App Store preview for one device class, up to 4 captions, a sound bed or silence, the poster frame and the spec report. 3 days, 1 round of revisions.

offers.name: Standard
offers.description: Up to 2 previews, or iPhone and iPad sizes, plus the Google Play video, its feature graphic and the YouTube settings checklist. 4 days, 2 rounds of revisions.

offers.name: Launch
offers.description: Standard, plus 9:16 and 4:5 social cuts with up to 3 opening lines and captions in one more language. 5 days, 2 rounds of revisions.

offers.name: Agency 5-pack
offers.description: Five apps at Starter scope on one invoice, in 10 working days. 1 round of revisions per app.

tools.name: App Store preview video checker
tools.description: Checks an App Store preview video against Apple's App Preview specification in the browser: accepted size per device class, 15 to 30 seconds, up to 30 fps, H.264 up to High Profile Level 4.0 or ProRes 422 HQ, stereo AAC at 44.1 or 48 kHz, up to 500 MB. The file is read on the device and never uploaded.
featureList: Accepted size per device class, with the rotation flag
Length, frame rate and variable frame rate
Video codec, H.264 profile, level and progressive scan
Audio codec, channels and sample rate
A fix for every failed line, and one ffmpeg command

tools.name: Abandoned checkout calculator
tools.browserRequirements: Requires JavaScript. Runs in the browser; nothing typed into it is sent.
tools.description: Estimates the monthly Klaviyo-attributed revenue of a 3-email abandoned-checkout flow for a Shopify store, as a low, likely and high range from Klaviyo's published revenue per delivered email (25th and 75th percentile by yearly revenue and average order value). Runs in the browser.
featureList: Abandoned checkouts from sessions or orders, or the Shopify admin count
Klaviyo benchmark row by yearly revenue and average order value
Low, likely and high range a month and a year
Net of an existing one-email flow, or the gap of a full flow to the benchmarks
Every source with the date it was read

tools.name: Internal tool cost calculator
tools.browserRequirements: Requires JavaScript. Runs in the browser; nothing typed into it is sent.
tools.description: Compares per-seat no-code tools (Retool, Airtable, Softr, Glide, Notion) at list prices read on the vendors' own pages with a one-off custom tool on the buyer's own Cloudflare account, month by month, with the break-even month. Runs in the browser.
featureList: Cheapest plan that fits the team, per vendor
Builders and users billed the way each vendor bills them
Cumulative cost chart and break-even month
Optional care plan, and Cloudflare Access above 50 users
When the SaaS tool is the better choice
